insights.content: DTC #3 is 4-0, the only unbeaten team in Subflight A. Shi Oskooi (2.76→3.03, +0.27) is the model's most underrated player — the W1 D1 upset with Darian over Shirey (3.18) + Frazier (3.03) implies playing at 3.11+ level. Emmy Perez (2.85→2.99, 100% deployed) is the flex weapon. Every core player is trending up or stable.

The W3 3-2 win over Red Rock was tighter than expected — Prexy/Emmy lost D1 4-6 6-3 1-0, and Schnitz/Cunningham lost D3. DTC #3's doubles depth beyond the Shi/Darian pair is the vulnerability. Kara Gaston (2.93→2.81) and Lisa Schnitz (2.95→2.91) are confirmed overrated — both deployed at D3 only and lost.

Most overrated dynamics: Desiree Mcivor (Red Rock, 2.82→2.62, -0.19), Sandra Shearer (Anthem, 2.91→2.72, -0.19), Casey Primmer (Anthem, 3.17→3.11, D3 only despite highest team dynamic). On DTC #3: Gaston (2.93→2.81) and Schnitz (2.95→2.91) are overrated.

Most underrated: Shi Oskooi (2.76→3.03, +0.27), Kinsey Wolanski (Red Rock, 2.44→2.67, +0.23), Brittany Carlson (Summerlin, 2.71→2.86, +0.15), Maryam Kaveh (Red Rock, 2.63→2.76, +0.14), Chelsi Grady (Anthem, 2.86→3.00, +0.13), Crystal Ziebarth (Anthem, 2.83→2.97, +0.14).

Biggest D1 threats: Shirey (3.18) + Frazier (3.03) at DTC #2 (2-1 together). Biggest S1 threats: Tayoni Coleman (Summerlin, 3.08→3.10, 3-0), Nourjan Bonney (Desert Palm, 2.97→3.07, 3-0). S1 matchup to watch: Yarisbel Schieck vs Tayoni Coleman on 5/2.

Spanish Trail (4-0) and Desert Palm (3-1) dominate Subflight B. Note: Desert Palm's ratings are flat despite good records — they beat weak opponents. Kristyl Addison (3.06→3.06, 4-0) hasn't proved anything above baseline because every opponent was rated well below her. Club Ridges (0-4) is winless.

sections.title: 04/18 — next match preview: DTC #3 vs ANTHEM CC

insights.content: DTC #3 (4-0) hosts Anthem CC (3-1). Anthem's lone loss was 1-4 to Summerlin in W4. This is the biggest test remaining in the first half — both at the top of Subflight A.

Anthem's likely D1: Chelsi Grady (2.86→3.00, 2-1) + Crystal Ziebarth (2.83→2.97, 2-0) or Therese Laudenslager (3.05→2.98, 2-2) + Carrie Maddux (2.78→2.72, 1-2). Shi/Darian should be favored against either pair.
Anthem's S1 options: Gina Rivera (3.01→2.94, 1-2) or CHRISTINE McNair (3.14→3.12, 1-0). Against Yarisbel Schieck (3.07, 3-0) — slight edge to DTC #3. Rivera has two losses; McNair is less tested.
Anthem's D3 strength: Cynthia Lau (2-0) and Heather Rosenthal (1-1). DTC #3 needs a reliable D3 pair — don't send Gaston or Schnitz.
DTC #3 should win 3-2 or 4-1. D1 and S1 favor DTC #3. Swing lines are D2 (Kim Knotts vs Anthem's D2) and D3 (depends on deployment).
vs ANTHEM CC (3-1). Top-of-table clash. Advantage DTC #3 at D1 and S1.
vs TPC (2-1). Depth but no stars. Winnable 3-2 or 4-1.
vs SUMMERLIN ARBORS (2-2). Most dangerous remaining match. Tayoni Coleman (3-0) vs Yarisbel at S1 is the marquee line. Brittany Carlson (2.71→2.86, 3-1) is a wildcard.
vs SOUTHERN HIGHLANDS (1-3). Already beat them 4-1 in W2. Comfortable win expected.
vs RED ROCK CC (1-3). Already beat them 3-2 in W3. Should still win 3-2+.
DTC #3 controls their destiny. Win vs Anthem (4/18) and Summerlin (5/2) to lock 1st. Even splitting those keeps 1st given the 2-game lead.
